core_thesis.statement: The predator is fractal. The mechanism of information asymmetry exploitation is structurally identical across scales — from individual to institutional.
core_thesis.corollary: CYNIC makes no distinction of nature between these levels, only of scale. The infrastructure that stops the predator must be fractal too.
core_thesis.as_above_so_below: The psychopath of power operates through the same mechanism at every scale: exploit information asymmetry, silence the victim, capture the institutions that should stop you. The organism that counters this must apply the same remedy at every scale.

mechanism.name: information_asymmetry_exploitation
mechanism.invariant: Steps 2-6 are structurally identical regardless of scale. Only the actors and the surface change.

structural_incentive.statement: If the institution eradicates the threat, it loses its budget justification, its mandate expansion, and its political leverage. The threat must exist.
structural_incentive.falsifiable: Show a national law enforcement agency that achieved measurable reduction in target predation rate AND subsequently lost budget. If no such case exists, the structural incentive is empirically dominant.

scales.name: State Within the State
scales.description: Intelligence agencies, black budget programs, and parallel security apparatuses that operate outside the democratic oversight of the formal state they nominally serve. They write their own rules, classify their own actions, and prosecute those who expose them.
examples: CIA (US): documented covert ops beyond Congressional oversight — Church Committee 1975, MK-Ultra, Operation Gladio, Iran-Contra, extraordinary rendition post-9/11
NSA (US): mass surveillance beyond FISA court oversight — Snowden 2013, PRISM, XKeyscore, Five Eyes data sharing
DGSI/DST (France): domestic intelligence with documented political use cases, opaque oversight
FSB (Russia): operates as autonomous power center, documented political assassinations on foreign soil (Litvinenko, Skripal)
Mossad (Israel): targeted assassinations in foreign jurisdictions, autonomous from formal state accountability

mechanism_instance.power_source: classified authority, black budget (unaccountable), monopoly on threat narrative, access to all communications
mechanism_instance.exploitation: political targeting under national security framing, manufactured consent via information control, blackmail via mass surveillance
mechanism_instance.silencing: classification authority: expose us = treason. Snowden: exiled. Assange: imprisoned. Manning: imprisoned.
mechanism_instance.institutional_capture: the agency IS the oversight body in practice. FISA court: 99.97% approval rate 1978-2013. The court that never says no is not a court.
mechanism_instance.theater: congressional hearings where agency heads lie under oath without consequence (Clapper, 2013). Inspector General reports that are classified. Oversight committees briefed on programs they cannot discuss.

scales.structural_immunity: Black budget = no accountability to legislature. Classification authority = no public scrutiny. Prosecutorial immunity = no legal consequence for documented crimes. The oversight body is captured by the agency it oversees.
scales.epistemic_note: Observed at outcome level (Snowden docs, Church Committee, FISA records). The full scope is structurally unknowable — which is itself a product of the mechanism.

scales.name: Transnational Capital Infrastructure
scales.description: Entities that own the ownership layer of global capitalism — major institutional investors, central bank coordination bodies, payment infrastructure, and rating agencies. They do not govern states directly. They govern the conditions under which states can function.
examples: BlackRock/Vanguard/State Street: together hold 5-20% of virtually every major corporation globally (S&P 500, media, tech, defense, pharma, banking) — documented in SEC 13F filings. The same three firms are top shareholders of each other.
BIS (Bank for International Settlements): coordinates global central bank policy in Basel. No democratic mandate. 'The central bank of central banks.'
Federal Reserve: issues global reserve currency. Dollar hegemony = de facto global monetary policy without global democratic mandate.
Rating agencies (Moody's, S&P, Fitch): downgrade sovereign debt = structural adjustment = loss of state policy sovereignty. Documented in Greek crisis 2010, Argentina, multiple African states.
SWIFT: payment messaging infrastructure. Exclusion = economic warfare. Iran sanctions precedent. Russia 2022.

mechanism_instance.power_source: ownership of ownership: control the shareholders of the institutions that govern
mechanism_instance.exploitation: proxy voting on corporate governance → media editorial direction, tech policy, defense contracts, pharma approval timelines
mechanism_instance.silencing: not censorship — editorial ownership. The newspaper that shares a top shareholder with the pharmaceutical company does not need to be told what to suppress.
mechanism_instance.institutional_capture: revolving door between BlackRock and US Treasury/Fed is documented (Larry Fink advisory role). Rating agencies advised by the banks they rate on sovereign debt.
mechanism_instance.theater: ESG frameworks, diversity reports, stakeholder capitalism language — while actual ownership concentration increases. The predator speaks the language of the solution.

scales.structural_immunity: Legal. Ownership is legal. Proxy voting is legal. The mechanism operates entirely within the rules because the mechanism authors the rules.
scales.epistemic_note: Fully observed and documented in SEC filings, ownership databases. This is the most empirically solid scale in the model.

scales.description: Non-institutional networks of aligned individuals who coordinate policy, appointments, and resource allocation outside democratic structures. Range from partially documented (Freemasonry in judiciary/police, WEF Young Global Leaders) to speculative (deeper esoteric orders). The documented cases establish the pattern; the extent of the undocumented cases is by definition unknowable.

examples.mechanism: Mutual obligation network: member judges, prosecutors, police protect member predators. Not ideology — obligation. Omertà without the Sicilian accent.

examples.name: deeper_esoteric_orders
examples.note: Rosicrucians, inner circles of major lodges, orders not publicly documented. CYNIC applies phi_inverse here: at this epistemic distance, the model acknowledges the pattern (the nested structure of disclosed/undisclosed is itself a documented feature of esoteric organizations) but makes no normative claims. The absence of evidence is evidence of the mechanism, not evidence of absence.

scales.epistemic_note: This scale requires the most rigorous phi_inverse application. Pattern is observed (P2, documented masonic networks). Extent is inferred. Inner workings are conjecture. CYNIC marks each claim explicitly.
scales.cynic_phi_bound: Claims about this scale must be marked conjecture unless sourced to documentary evidence. The model acknowledges the scale exists without claiming to map its full extent — which would itself violate VERIFY.

scales.name: Dynastic and Theocratic Power Networks
scales.description: Families and religious institutions that have maintained structural power across generations — predating, founding, or deeply embedding within all other layers. Their distinguishing feature is time horizon: they operate on scales that make electoral cycles, corporate cycles, and agency mandates irrelevant. They do not capture institutions — they often founded them, or have been inside them long enough to become indistinguishable from them.
scales.why_above_parallel_governance: Parallel governance networks (Freemasonry, WEF, Skull & Bones) were themselves founded by, or serve as recruitment pools for, dynastic networks. The 19th-century lodge system was largely funded and structured by old European capital. The mechanism flows downward: dynasties create the initiation structures that create the obligation networks that staff the institutions.

nodes.name: Vatican_and_Holy_See
nodes.description: The most structurally complex node in the model: simultaneously a sovereign state (diplomatic immunity), a global religious authority (moral legitimacy over ~1.4B Catholics), a financial institution (IOR/Vatican Bank), a global property empire, an educational/healthcare infrastructure (schools, hospitals = soft power), and a dynastic family network (cardinal families).
documented_evidence: IOR (Vatican Bank) scandal: Roberto Calvi found hanging under Blackfriars Bridge, London, 1982. Documented links to P2 masonic lodge (Licio Gelli), Mafia (Cosa Nostra), and Archbishop Marcinkus. Parliamentary investigation confirmed IOR involvement in money laundering.

Propaganda Due (P2) lodge: Vatican officials including Marcinkus held membership alongside Italian heads of state, military chiefs, intelligence directors. Dissolved by Italian parliament 1981 after discovery of membership list.

Papal States families (Farnese, Colonna, Orsini, Borgia, Medici): documented centuries of producing popes, cardinals, and generals simultaneously — religious authority and dynastic capital were structurally unified.

Concordats: bilateral treaties between Holy See and sovereign states granting legal privileges (tax exemption, educational rights, property immunity) outside normal democratic legislative process. Currently ~180 concordats active.

Diplomatic immunity: Holy See has permanent observer status at UN, full bilateral diplomatic relations with 183 states. Cardinals cannot be extradited. Vatican City cannot be searched by Italian police.
nodes.cardinal_families_mechanism: In the historical model (pre-20th century), cardinal families — the great Roman noble houses — supplied the College of Cardinals which elected popes. The family that produced a pope controlled Vatican finances, appointments, and military. Religious legitimacy and dynastic capital were not two separate things. The reform of 1917 canon law separated these formally; the informal networks persisted.
nodes.modern_jesuits_note: The Society of Jesus (Jesuits) historically functioned as the intelligence and education arm of the papacy — global network, linguistic training, access to ruling families across continents. Pope Francis is the first Jesuit pope.

scales.structural_immunity: Time is the ultimate immunity. Democratic accountability operates in 4-year cycles. Legal accountability requires evidence that private archives control. Generational transfer is legal. The dynasty simply waits out every reform cycle.
scales.cynic_phi_bound: This is the scale where phi_inverse enforcement is most critical. Historical facts (P2, IOR, abuse royal commissions) are observed. Family coordination mechanisms are inferred. Claims about inter-dynasty coordination or the existence of a unified apex are conjecture and must be marked as such. CYNIC does not claim to map what it cannot see.
scales.epistemic_hard_limit: The fractal model acknowledges that above this layer, the map runs out. Not because nothing exists, but because the evidence resolution required to make normative claims is structurally inaccessible. CYNIC applies phi_inverse: maximum confidence 61.8% on any claim at this scale. The honest position is to map what is documented, mark what is inferred, and hold the boundary at conjecture.

institutional_theater_pattern.definition: Institutional theater is the structural condition in which an institution charged with eliminating a harmful phenomenon has stronger incentives to maintain the phenomenon than to eradicate it.
institutional_theater_pattern.cynic_position: CYNIC does not defer to institutions for resolution of what institutions have structural incentive to leave unresolved. KYON makes institutional inaction itself a Proof of Observation — as visible and as permanent as the predation it fails to address.

from_below.principle: The community enforces. The math decides. No institution permission required.
from_below.independence: Community ban happens whether or not any state actor acts. The victim does not wait.

from_above.principle: KYON is not an argument for surveillance. It is the third path — sovereign community enforcement that makes the surveillance argument unnecessary. If KYON is deployed, 'we need to scan all messages to protect children' loses its empirical ground.

geopolitical_thesis.statement: KYON at planetary scale produces a geopolitical nasse: predators pushed off mainstream platforms concentrate in environments where state actors already have legitimate, targeted enforcement tools (dark web, Tor). KYON does not compete with Europol — it feeds the funnel that leads there. But if Europol is theater, the funnel still works: the community ban is the consequence, not the arrest.
geopolitical_thesis.second_order_effect: Mass migration of predators to dark web forces development of new anonymization infrastructure. This same infrastructure protects dissidents, journalists, and activists. The arms race drives privacy technology forward regardless of KYON's intent.
geopolitical_thesis.third_order_effect: States use predator migration as justification for Chat Control mandates. KYON's existence is the counter-argument: the outcome (reduced mainstream predation) is achieved without mass surveillance infrastructure. States that deploy Chat Control after KYON is available are demonstrably choosing surveillance over child protection.
